header.running_head: Conviction in the Recompense for Actions

blocks.text: kept in store for you and be given in full on the Day of Qiyaamah. Confirmation for this appears in Allaah's Book where He says:

blocks.arabic_text: وَمَآ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ
blocks.text: (O mankind!) The misfortunes that afflict you (in this world) are a result of the (evil) actions you earn, and (because of your many sins, you deserve to suffer even more adversities, but) Allaah pardons a great deal (of your sins, because of which you are spared many more hardships).[^1]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) reports that he was once with Rasulullaah ﷺ when the verse was revealed:

blocks.arabic_text: مَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْٓءًا يُّجْزَ بِهٖ ۙ وَلَا يَجِدْ لَهٗ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيْرًا
blocks.text: Whoever commits an evil act will meet (receive) its punishment and will not find for himself any friend nor any assistant besides Allaah.

Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "O Abu Bakr! Should I not recite to you a verse that was just revealed to me?" When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) asked to hear it, Rasulullaah ﷺ recited it for him. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) says, "All I know is that it seemed my back was about to break, causing me to yawn. 'What is the matter with you, O Abu Bakr?' Rasulullaah ﷺ asked.' I said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Which of us do not sin? Will we be punished for everything we do wrong?' Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, 'As for you and the Mu'mineen, you will suffer retribution (for your sins) in this world so that you have no sins to your account when you meet Allaah. However, the others (the Kuffaar) shall have their accounts accrued until they are punished for it on the Day of Qiyaamah."[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) once asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! When we will be punished for every sin, who can keep himself in good stead after the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: مَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ سُوۡٓءًا يُّجۡزَ بِهٖۙ وَ لَا يَجِدۡ لَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيۡرًا
blocks.text: Whoever commits an evil act will meet (receive) its punishment...

Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "May Allaah forgive you, O Abu Bakr! Do you not fall ill? Do you not get tired? Do you never feel depressed? Do you never suffer hardship? Do calamities never befall you?" "These things do happen," Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "This is the retribution (for your sins) in this world."[^3]
